================================================================================
Create trigger with timing and when
================================================================================

CREATE TEMP TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS main.tr BEFORE INSERT ON t FOR EACH ROW WHEN new.a IS NULL
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a is null');
  INSERT INTO log VALUES (new.b);
  DELETE FROM u WHERE id = new.id;
END;
